verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gitleaks is developed in a public GitHub repository, so its source appears readable. It can be installed via Go, ships an example pre-commit.py script, and is described by its creator as a long-running project. However, no item in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an OSI-approved open license (e.g. MIT/Apache), and independent confirmation of the license terms.
